professionalSummary.text: Built and maintained Java-based REST services for claims processing with automated testing and data protection compliance.
professionalSummary.witness: built the claims-intake API in Java (Spring Boot) that accepts first notice of loss from the web form and the call-centre tool, with unit and integration tests in the build

experienceHighlights.text: Released claims-intake API version 3 to production on 18 July 2023 under change CHG-77140 following approval at the weekly change board, deploying in the Tuesday evening release slot.
experienceHighlights.witness: Released claims-intake API version 3 to production on 18 July 2023 under change CHG-77140 following approval at the weekly change board, deploying in the Tuesday evening release slot.

experienceHighlights.text: Held production deploy rights and served on the claims-platform on-call rota from August 2023 to March 2024, covering about one week in five.
experienceHighlights.witness: the candidate held production deploy rights and was a primary on-call engineer for the claims-intake API from August 2023 to March 2024, covering about one week in five.

skills.text: Java (Spring Boot), REST API development, automated testing, data protection compliance, contract testing, change management.
skills.witness: built the claims-intake API in Java (Spring Boot) that accepts first notice of loss from the web form and the call-centre tool, with unit and integration tests in the build

The materials do not establish the candidate's direct involvement in scaling services during peak claim volumes or the specific data-protection standards applied.

decisionBoundary.statement: Human review required to assess the candidate's fit for the role based on the evidence provided.

evidence.text: built the claims-intake API in Java (Spring Boot) that accepts first notice of loss from the web form and the call-centre tool, with unit and integration tests in the build.
evidence.notes: Direct evidence of Java REST service development with automated tests

evidence.notes: Direct evidence of contract test maintenance

evidence.text: Released claims-intake API version 3 to production on 18 July 2023 under change CHG-77140 following approval at the weekly change board, deploying in the Tuesday evening release slot.
evidence.notes: Direct evidence of production release through change approval

evidence.text: Work sample: change record CHG-77140, with the change-board approval, the deployment steps executed, the post-deployment smoke-test results and the rollback plan, listing the candidate as implementer and the change manager as approver.
the candidate held production deploy rights and was a primary on-call engineer for the claims-intake API from August 2023 to March 2024, covering about one week in five.
evidence.notes: Direct evidence of on-call rota participation

evidence.text: Masked bank details and policyholder phone numbers in the API's logs after a data-protection review, and added a unit test that fails if unmasked values appear.
evidence.notes: Direct evidence of data protection compliance
